sloka: लोकप्रवादः सत्योऽयं पण्डितैः समुदाहृतः ।अकाले दुर्लभो मृत्युः स्त्रिया वा पुरुषस्य वा ।। ५.२३.१२।।।।
transliteration: lokapravādaḥ satyo'yaṁ paṇḍitaiḥ samudāhṛtaḥ ।akāle durlabho mṛtyuḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā ।। 5.23.12।।।।

translations.english: 'Why don't you wish to be the wife of such a mighty and powerful king, a valiant hero who has never beaten a retreat in war?
